frontCrossCheck.unit: Blender world metres of the source glb, before the turn
frontCrossCheck.meaning: centroid shift of the body mesh, idle -> attack_tele peak (windup) and idle -> attack_act/dive_act end (strike): windup +X and strike -X means the front is -X
frontCrossCheck.note: 7 of 9 show windup back (+X) and strike forward (-X), always along X not Y. spider (0.026/-0.010) and worm (0.012/+0.010) are too small to read. The bone-axis vector alone is ambiguous for fetal, spider, mother, wraith, slime, womb (see frontFix.front_vector_before): the declared facing in the reports (-X) is trusted there. Mac capture must confirm the 9 faces.
